reason: The newest change items (2026-05-06 modify tunnel bandwidth, 2025-11-12 5 Gbps tunnels, 2025-09-25 LBT launch) add or extend LBT but none lifts the accelerated VPN restriction; the saved VPNTunnels page (the same page the fact quotes) still lists it, and the accelerated-vpn page shows no LBT support.

The 2026-05-06 change lets you switch an existing connection between standard (1.25 Gbps) and large (5 Gbps) but does not allow mixed tunnels; the saved VPNTunnels page still states both tunnels must use the same bandwidth configuration, and no newer item replaces it.
